_comment: Single source of truth for every checkable fact about the seller, the branches and the prices. Imported by src/config/site.ts (pages + JSON-LD) and read by scripts/build-llms.mjs (llms*.txt). Plain JSON because the generator is .mjs and cannot import .ts — same pattern as infusedSlugs.json. Never retype any value below into content; add a placeholder to the llms templates instead.

hours.displayMs: 8:00 pagi – 12:00 tengah malam, Isnin hingga Ahad
hours.displayAr: من 8:00 صباحاً حتى 12:00 منتصف الليل، من الاثنين إلى الأحد
hours.note: Festive days such as Hari Raya can differ — confirm on WhatsApp.

branches.street: Putra Sulaiman, 17-L1, Persiaran Putra Sulaiman, Taman Putra Sulaiman
32, Jalan Prima SG 2, Prima Seri Gombak

restaurant.street: 1541, Persiaran Putra Sulaiman, Taman Putra Sulaiman
restaurant.note: No trading name was supplied by the owner — do not invent one.

prices.appliesTo: Same price by size for the classic oil and for every flavour of the Infused Collection (owner answer Q12, read as price-by-size — see docs/llms-rebuild-spec.md).

compliance.ruleEn: Malaysian Food Regulations 1985, Regulation 18(6): food may not be labelled or advertised as preventing, alleviating, treating or curing any disease. Benefit words appear in the keyword lists as terms people search for — never as a claim about this product.
compliance.ruleMs: Peraturan-Peraturan Makanan 1985, Peraturan 18(6): makanan tidak boleh dilabel atau diiklankan sebagai mencegah, melegakan, merawat atau menyembuhkan sebarang penyakit. Perkataan khasiat muncul dalam senarai kata kunci sebagai apa yang orang cari — bukan sebagai dakwaan tentang produk ini.
compliance.ruleAr: لوائح الأغذية الماليزية 1985، المادة 18(6): لا يجوز وصف أي غذاء أو الإعلان عنه على أنه يمنع مرضاً أو يخففه أو يعالجه أو يشفيه. وكلمات الفوائد ترد في قوائم الكلمات المفتاحية بوصفها ما يبحث عنه الناس — لا بوصفها ادّعاءً عن هذا المنتج.
